initialization_boundary_census: Owned Chrome CDP connection, command-line/profile ownership, extension worker discovery and Playwright attachment passed because execution reached panel_context.
The owned localhost page was created and navigated, the trusted Open panel click returned opened=true, and the exact panel target was found distinct from the normal page.

The worker Runtime.evaluate call returned an array from chrome.runtime.getContexts for SIDE_PANEL contexts; otherwise the code would have thrown native_sidepanel_runtime_context_query_failed rather than context_missing.

The single immediate context query returned no entry satisfying contextType SIDE_PANEL, exact panel documentUrl and tabId -1 together. Its array was discarded, so the retained run cannot distinguish an empty array, wrong extension/document URL, wrong tab ID, or registration timing.
Panel settle, screenshot, guest account, and Scrape cases were not reached.
causal_limit: The exact retained failure proves only the missing triple match at one query. It does not prove a timing race, extension initialization defect, Chrome bug, or product Scrape failure. The previous D107 endpoint timeout did not recur, but this run does not prove D107 fixed.

source_change.behavior: When the initial exact context check fails, emit BROWSER_PANEL_CONTEXT_FAILURE with counts for all returned contexts, SIDE_PANEL type, expected extension, exact URL, global tab ID, and complete triple match.
source_change.privacy: Only integer counts are logged. Raw document URLs, context IDs, tab IDs other than equality with -1, process details, and arbitrary exception text are not emitted.
source_change.invariants: The exact required context match, single query, existing wait deadlines, ownership checks, resource guard, and cleanup are unchanged. No retry or acceptance bypass was added.
